meta.levelsMeaning: Minimum reachable character level is derived by minimax over enabled route thresholds, starting from Moonrise Beach, and includes completed starter quest500000003 at level5 for main-world access. Quest/item/account checks remain separate mandatory conditions; monster levels are never used as entry levels.
